entities.title: zazzle-agent-rules-list
entities.summary: `zazzle agent list-rules PATH`: prints the rule files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules) and skill files (SKILL.md) that apply to a path, from the home folder and every folder above the path, closest last.
entities.purpose: The crate of the zazzle-agent binary: Cargo.toml, the user README, and the library, binary and tests in src/. It is one member of the Cargo workspace in macos/rust.
boundaries: It only lists file paths; it never reads rule contents or decides which rules matter to a task.
The zazzle invoker (macos/c/zazzle) runs it for `zazzle agent ARGS` by exec'ing the zazzle-agent binary beside itself; it never goes through the zazzled daemon.
Packaging zazzle-agent in releases is the release scripts' concern, not this folder's.

relationships.description: The invoker that execs zazzle-agent for `zazzle agent`.
